memoryDomainStorage.note: ADR-0009 permits plaintext only for the memory-domain fields listed in the memory contract, including source-index text. Data categories and access restrictions remain unchanged. Account data, provider credentials, legacy Go message bodies and encrypted export-object envelopes retain their existing field or object encryption. Notification text is not a credential category and is not a memory-domain field.

document.note: W09 follow-up lifecycle. SCHEDULED is the only triggerable status and requires an explicit trigger instant. A MemoryTime normalization of needs_clarification, or a date-only time without a confirmed reminder rule, cannot be written as that instant. Proactive greeting defaults off. Enabling it without a declared offline capability yields WAITING_HOST and must not claim the host already replied. Go creates and cancels rows only from a published memory whose source was verified again and from the saved MemoryTime. V39 vc.reminder stays unchanged for W11. MemoryCore proposals and model tools do not write this table.

The API consumer matrix remains the deletion/scope source. KEEP requires core-outcome, current H5 production caller, safety/data-rights, or Owner instruction. DEFER/RETIRE with H5 callers must hide or delete that entry in the same later slice that removes the OpenAPI operation. This file is the OpenAPI deletion list: RETIRE operations are removed with H5 in a later slice, not in G0.

W11 one session-bound tool entry. The model cannot name an owner or relationship. query_scheduled_follow_ups returns that binding's SCHEDULED follow-ups. manage_reminder creates or cancels a vc.reminder, or cancels one follow-up of the same binding. The execution row commits before the business row. The same idempotency key returns the same execution. document.note: V2 recall resolves owner, character instance and mode from the authenticated ST conversation binding before searching. A shared card template is never a shared memory scope. STORY bindings do not consume ordinary companion memory.

retrievalPolicy.failure: Ordinary companion chat may continue with verified current card/history and an explicit skipped-memory state. No ordinary-memory fallback is allowed for STORY. Rebuilding embedding spaces permit current lexical retrieval only; legacy vc.memory_embedding is not a production fallback.
retrievalPolicy.finalRequest: The ST native extension uses a separately named history-data block. Each of the three protocol exits recalls again before sending and replaces or removes the earlier block. Source changes, unavailable sources and disabled recall cannot retain an old block or use an unverified summary as fallback.
retrievalPolicy.selection: Filter by owner, instance, mode and allowed SESSION/RELATIONSHIP scope first; Build a trusted allowlist from published current Go projections. MemoryCore ranks candidates within that set before KNN/FTS top-K, using only the current embedding space and rejecting low relevance before fusion. Reconcile each candidate and L2/L3 summary's complete persisted source dependencies before selecting and applying the token budget.
retrievalPolicy.time: Keep source timestamp/timezone, recording time, normalized local event date/time and reminder instant distinct. Relative source expressions use their saved source timezone and calendar; queries use their own snapshot. Unknown or ambiguous time stays needs_clarification. A date never creates a midnight reminder.

document.note: Per-capability status of a model profile (image/video/pdf input, structured output, tool calls, native web search, system message). Administrators may declare UNKNOWN, DECLARED or UNSUPPORTED. VERIFIED is written only by an explicit verification action and never inferred from a model id; an administrator may echo it unchanged for a field the same profile already has verified, but a new profile, a clone (new profileKey) or an upgrade from another status is rejected.

Derived per binding from its own state and the referenced provider/profile. Only READY may be resolved by the SillyTavern server plugin; disabling or clearing a key moves the binding out of READY for the next request.

entries.note: Foreground SillyTavern turns pin this binding. Tool follow-up turns share the same binding and are reserved as TOOL_TURN. Missing price, missing budget, or a monthly cap performs no real call. The hold is the priced token cap, at most the per-call ceiling. The output count is the request max output, not an expected length. A timeout keeps that estimate and is not released as zero.
Local embedding calls are a non-billed count. They are not reported as a zero-dollar online cost and do not enter the monthly cost budget.

document.note: V2 G2 purposes (ADR-0009, snapshot ARCH §17.4 / fixtures/model_profiles.json). Each purpose pins one model profile independently; changing one binding never touches another. EMBEDDING uses the dedicated Go embedding configuration (W08), never a chat profile. Its snapshot pins the Ollama artifact digest, dimensions, preprocessing and normalization; any vector-space-defining change allocates a new spaceId. Rebuilding uses lexical recall only.
